# Deliberate changes to the public OpenAPI schema, one JSON pointer fragment
# per line. Anything NOT listed fails verify-api — that is the part that
# protects you.
#
# The refactor itself changed nothing here; these are separate improvements.
#
# LIFECYCLE: entries are relative to whatever CI compares against (a PR's base
# branch, or the previous commit). Once merged, a change exists in the base too
# and its entry stops matching — remove it then, or the gate quietly narrows.

# Six list/detail pairs shared an auto-generated operationId, which Spectacular
# resolved with "_2" suffixes assigned by URL traversal order. That made SDK
# method names unstable: reordering routes could swap them between the list and
# detail endpoint. Now pinned explicitly. Paths and payloads are unchanged.
operationId

# Stage 20: staff-only model-health dashboard. Additive — a new path, no change
# to any existing operation.
/api/algo/model-health/

# Stage 21: public reporting dataset. Additive. Two paths, deliberately split:
# the public one is served with Cache-Control: public and carries aggregates
# only, so the row-level export is staff-only on its own uncached path rather
# than a query flag on the public one.
/api/algo/public/dataset/
/api/algo/public/dataset/export/
